run_benchmark_chart: run the script with a benchmark JSON file to generate a histogram iteration performance chart
parse_benchmark_json: parse benchmark JSON data extracting name, histogram type, dimension, coverage, and bin count
plot_cpu_time_per_bin: plot CPU time per bin across tuple, vector, and vector_of_variant axis types on a log-log scale
extract_cpu_model: extract the CPU model name from /proc/cpuinfo and set it as the chart title
compare_naive_vs_indexed: compare naive nested-for versus indexed histogram iteration strategies by dimension and bin count
